summary: Configured node1 to require passwords of at least 12 characters containing at least three character classes. The policy persisted through a verified node restart; the operating-system release and kernel remained unchanged.
actions_performed: Preserved the existing RHEL 10 pam_pwquality/authselect integration without installing or upgrading software.
Verified an 11-character four-class candidate is rejected, a long two-class candidate is rejected, and a compliant candidate is accepted.
Restarted node1 exactly once, confirmed its boot ID changed, and reverified system health and policy behavior.
Removed temporary test and reboot artifacts; no test accounts or credentials were retained.

evidence.requirement: Require new passwords to be at least 12 characters and use at least three character classes.
evidence.summary: Shows the installed minlen/minclass settings and direct pre- and post-restart rejection and acceptance tests.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel and use compatible software.
evidence.summary: Confirms RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, installed PAM/libpwquality integration, and the same OS/kernel after restart.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart persistence and recovery.
evidence.summary: Captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot-ID change from 6ab6a71b-188c-48ae-971b-a6bb378b1d72 to c30b5083-202a-4687-aaf0-27b8ec3ff145, and recovered running state with valid authselect configuration and persisted policy behavior.
